description: Create a new AI persona with avatar, voice, language, and niche prompt. avatarUrl is REQUIRED: every persona has a face. A video without a face is a per-video choice — set options.faceless on generate_persona_video.

avatarUrl.description: REQUIRED. Public URL to the persona avatar image (use list_faces for stock face URLs). Every persona has a face; "no face" is chosen per video with generate_persona_video options.faceless.

faceQuality.description: Face resolution of the rendered videos: ok (480p, 2 tokens/video) or very_good (720p, 3 tokens/video)

imagePrimaryIndex.description: Index into images[] marking the primary library image (no primary is set when omitted)

images.description: Up to 10 local image files of the same person for the persona image library. Each video deterministically picks the best-matching image by tag.

description.description: Description of the photo for tag/keyword matching (e.g. smiling at the beach at sunset)

path.description: Local file path to the image (JPG/JPEG, PNG, or WebP, max 10MB)

tag.description: Short tag for deterministic per-video matching (e.g. casual, formal, gym)

language.description: Language code — English only for now (e.g. en-US, en-GB)

scriptPrompt.description: System prompt instructions for video scripts

videoLayout.description: How the persona hook is composed with the video material: "standard" fills the frame with the avatar, "react" splits it in half (persona on top, video material below: real clips or drawings). Same render cost either way.

voiceId.description: id or label from list_voices. Never type a provider prefix.

name: create_persona
